answer: Admission by capped cohorts: new agents join only via cohorts capped at 2% of the population per epoch, seats sold by sealed-bid auction with bids burned. Validators verify each cohort on-chain and burn the clearing price before new identities gain weight. A sybil wanting many fakes cannot mint them at once: capturing a 10,000-agent economy means winning 50 straight cohorts at rising prices, so each fake burns capital like harvested timber. Honest demand flows like a river into the meadow of real participation, so attack costs track true value, not keypair generation.
